title: RCMP inquest response displeases victim's family
article: The RCMP says it's following recommendations made by a jury last fall at an inquest into the police shooting of Delbert Kenneth Pelletier. Mr. Pelletier's relatives say they're not satisfied and plan to hold a news conference today to air their grievances.
The 44-year-old died when a police sniper fired a single shot him after a standoff on the Muskowekwan First Nation on Nov. 13, 2006.
